title: Choose observation or comparison context
statement: As a developer inspecting a Saga, I can open one committed revision or compare a committed change so evidence and change layers are evaluated against an explicit, reproducible range.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Opening a Saga without an against revision reports observe mode at the selected head and reports no comparison layers or changed lines.
Opening with against and head revisions reports compare mode using their actual merge base as the base commit and the resolved head commit as the head.
Requesting WORKTREE as the source head is rejected with guidance to commit the work before comparing it.
